source.title: ENTSO-E Transmission Grid Investment and Supply Chain Assessment Report 2026
source.locator: Report pp. 11, 15-16, 33; press release dated 3 November
source.boundary: Reported plans and generic lead time, not orders, project delivery promises or observed profits. No cancellation probabilities, fees or commercial quotes supplied.

assumptions.cost_boundary: Synthetic wind developer connection: reservation fee paid now, not credited against equipment; exercise premium at approval if proceeding; cancellation refund at decision month. Common transformer price and payment schedule assumed identical at approval in both options and cancel out. Contribution is net of generation OPEX and electricity/route-to-market costs. No tax, debt, inflation, equipment capex timing differences, storage, residual value or terminal cash beyond month 72. Additional holding or engineering costs must be included in fee/premium or model extended. No claim that suppliers offer these terms.
